{
  "outcome": "translated",
  "clause_id": "l1108_1368_n004",
  "abstain_reason": null,
  "claims": [
    "C1 OpenAI is exploring how to permit developers and users to generate erotica and gore in age-appropriate contexts via API and ChatGPT",
    "C2 such generation is permitted only so long as usage policies are met",
    "C3 a hard line is drawn against sexual abuse content such as sexual deepfakes and revenge porn"
  ],
  "acts": ["generate_content(C)"],
  "concepts": [
    {
      "name": "erotica_or_gore",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "content that is erotica or gore, as distinct from sexual abuse content",
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l1108_1368_n004",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "age_appropriate_context",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "a context in which the content is age-appropriate, such as through the API or ChatGPT with appropriate safeguards",
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l1108_1368_n004",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "sexual_abuse_content",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "potentially harmful uses like sexual deepfakes and revenge porn",
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l1108_1368_n004",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "usage_policies",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "OpenAI's usage policies that constrain what content may be generated",
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l1108_1368_n004",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "meets_usage_policies",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "the generation of content C complies with OpenAI's usage policies",
      "licence": "assumed",
      "cites": null,
      "inference": "the clause conditions permission on usage policies being met, so a relation between a generation and policy compliance is needed",
      "toggleable": false
    }
  ],
  "ontology": [],
  "asserts": [
    {
      "read_back": "generating % is permitted when % is erotica or gore, the context is age-appropriate, and the generation meets usage policies",
      "read_back_slots": ["C", "C"],
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l1108_1368_n004",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false,
      "status": "permit",
      "act": "generate_content(C)",
      "body": "erotica_or_gore(C), age_appropriate_context(C), meets_usage_policies(C)"
    },
    {
      "read_back": "generating % is forbidden because % is sexual abuse content such as sexual deepfakes or revenge porn",
      "read_back_slots": ["C", "C"],
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l1108_1368_n004",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false,
      "status": "forbid",
      "act": "generate_content(C)",
      "body": "sexual_abuse_content(C)"
    }
  ],
  "beats": [],
  "defines": [],
  "closure": [
    {
      "act_class": "generate_content",
      "closure": "cnpa",
      "reason": "the clause explicitly permits only content meeting usage policies and age-appropriate contexts, and draws a hard line against sexual abuse content; silence about other content is not a grant of permission"
    }
  ],
  "requires": ["usage_policies/1"],
  "inputs": ["erotica_or_gore/1", "age_appropriate_context/1", "meets_usage_policies/1", "sexual_abuse_content/1"],
  "forbid_body": []
}
